profile: unsupervised learning: Unsupervised learning is treated as self-supervised learning (SSL). Training samples can be unlabeled. Node embedding is described as unsupervised or self-supervised. Self-regeneration is characterized as self-supervised/unsupervised, and generative graph neural network tasks are described as self-supervised/unsupervised. When generating graphs without a ground-truth target graph, the setting is considered self/unsupervised.
